parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a circular cover made of stainless steel that fits on top of the kettle to prevent heat and steam from escaping.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the kettle to retain heat and pressure while boiling water and can be removed for filling or cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an arched component made of heat-resistant Bakelite, attached to the top of the kettle for safe handling.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and pour the kettle without touching the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the kettle, made of stainless steel, with a spout for pouring and an opening for the lid.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and heats the water, distributing heat evenly across its surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be tilted when pouring.
